verdict.rationale: Docs mention voice mode ('Talk to Grok hands-free with voice') and cross-platform sync of conversations/settings/subscriptions, implying mobile app support, but there is no explicit confirmation of dedicated full-featured iOS and Android apps, no app-store links, and no community/hands-on feedback about mobile app quality or feature parity with desktop/web. Missing for 10: explicit iOS/Android app documentation, feature-parity details, and independent user reviews of the mobile apps themselves.
